headline: Approved Timothy McGrath's contract as Chief Financial Officer and a one-year SKESP contract extension for SY 2026-2027.
summary: The committee approved the Chief Financial Officer contract for Timothy McGrath, a one-year SKESP contract extension, staffing increases for a school psychologist, SKESP at Peace Dale Elementary School, and a social worker, and joining a request for a joint advisory opinion from the Rhode Island Attorney General on school committee agendas. The committee also reviewed the Superintendent's Report and got updates on school opening, transportation, the new high school project, and discussed School Committee goals with no vote taken.
decisions: Approved the Chief Financial Officer contract for Timothy McGrath, 4-0.
Approved the Consent Agenda, including minutes, purchase orders over $10,350, and homeschool requests, 4-0.
Sealed the Minutes of the Executive Session of July 28, 2026, 4-0.
Approved a One-Year SKESP Contract Extension for SY 2026-2027, 3-0-1 (Restivo abstained).
Approved the Superintendent's staffing increase recommendations: .1 increase to School Psychologist, 1.0 increase to SKESP at Peace Dale Elementary School, and .5 increase to Social Worker, 4-0.
Approved joining the efforts of Henneous Lombardo et al in a request for a joint advisory opinion from the Rhode Island Attorney General's Office on school committee agendas, 4-0.
